newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen up, but less sharply than Dow.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen up, but less sharply than Dow.

text.p: Shares were seen opening higher after the Dow industrials posted their second biggest one-day gain ever, but the rise here was expected to be less spectacular, brokers said.

"Expectations are positive... Hopefully we'll rise more than one percent," one broker said, but added: "I don't think we'll rise as fast (as Wall St) because the decline here was less steep," he said.
"I think we could rise by one percent to one and a half percent," another broker predicted.
The strong dollar was seen boosting cyclicals and Nokia.
Nokia alone, which closed in New York on Tuesday at about 305.60 markka, or 5.60 markka above its Helsinki close, would probably help the index higher, brokers said.
